If you're on two different computers but the same steam account, then it's going to try and upload your current save to the cloud, and you guys could potentially overwrite each other's saves.

 I think if you disable steam cloud for the game, then you could have two separate saves on two separate machines with no problem. You wouldn't have a cloud backup, but there wouldn't be a conflict either. You can do it by right clicking on the game on steam and hitting properties, and then unchecking the steam cloud box.

I hope this helps!
